players.product: Ultra-fine, high-purity nickel-based powders for MLCC electrodes (volume supply to global MLCC makers); also copper and silver-coated copper powders

quarterly_data.quarter: Boqian New Materials results briefing Q&A: H1 2026 (09-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 results briefing (company's pre-collected answers): H1 2026 interest expense was RMB 4,992,620.35 (34.19% of financial expenses) and FX loss RMB 9,218,385.97 (63.13%); the company hedges RMB-appreciation risk with forward FX contracts and options. Asset impairment losses were RMB 8,052,904.55 and credit impairment losses RMB 4,417,669.58; inventory book balance was RMB 518,720,785.56 at period end and inventory turnover days shortened year on year. Alloy powders were no more than 2% of main-product revenue in H1 2026 because inductor customers are cost-constrained and large-scale use has not started; nano silicon and silicon-alloy powders for advanced battery anodes are still in evaluation with battery makers. Silver-coated copper products have shipped and added copper-based revenue in the period, at different stages (validation, small batch) across PV technology routes and customers.
quarterly_data.figure: FX loss RMB 9,218,385.97; interest RMB 4,992,620.35; alloy powders no more than 2% of main-product revenue

quarterly_data.quarter: Boqian New Materials results briefing Q&A: H1 2026 (09-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 results briefing (company view): leading MLCC makers' expansion and AI-server demand for high-capacitance MLCC support the nickel-powder industry; for Boqian this mainly means phased demand increments from core customers' expansion and a structural shift to finer particle sizes, but MLCC capacity growth does not translate proportionally into nickel-powder tonnage, and 2027 growth, prices and supply-demand remain uncertain; the company will match orders with capacity build-out. It keeps deepening work with large core customers while adding small and mid-size customers and new applications.
